drhp.business: The Company has not carried out any manufacturing operations for the past several years and is not currently engaged in any business activity. Following a change of control via a Share Purchase Agreement and open offer, present management has altered the object clause to enter the tourism and hospitality sector and proposes to develop an integrated industrial and recreational park (hospitality, healthcare, retail and commercial facilities) on the Company's existing land at Chingavanam, Kottayam, Kerala, pending statutory and regulatory approvals from the Department of Revenue, Government of Kerala.
drhp.expansion: The Company plans to develop an integrated industrial and recreational park comprising hospitality, healthcare, retail and commercial facilities on its existing land at Chingavanam, Kottayam, Kerala, subject to obtaining requisite statutory and regulatory approvals; commencement of commercial operations is envisaged in a phased manner. The Company has not carried out any manufacturing operations for the past several years and has no licensed or installed manufacturing capacity.

litigation.note: An Arbitration Award (09.12.2015) directed the Company to pay Rs. 79.50 Lakhs in a matter between Mr. T. Baburaj and the Company (ARC No. 4 of 2014 / A.R. No. 38/2011, High Court of Kerala); both parties have filed appeals before the District Court, Kottayam, and the matter is pending adjudication, disclosed as a contingent liability. Separately, a Central Excise refund claim (balance Rs. 44,86,993) relating to Calcium Carbide manufacturing is pending before CEGAT, New Delhi and is disclosed as an unrecognised contingent asset. Read in the Notes to Financial Statements (Contingent Liability / Contingent Asset notes).

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Diversify into the tourism and hospitality sector following the 2018 alteration of the object clause, developing an integrated industrial and recreational park (hospitality, healthcare, retail, commercial) on the Company's Chingavanam land.
